verdict.summary: The release gui-bundle job now installs an exactly versioned wasm-pack through a SHA-pinned, architecture-aware prebuilt installer before the wasm build. The added hermetic test meaningfully checks the load-bearing properties against the real workflow: arm64 matrix presence, absence of the source-install path and architecture-blind action, exact tool selection, action pinning, uniqueness, and ordering. The test executes successfully, and the docs-quality workflow runs it. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect is evident in the scoped change.
